signIn.sessionExists: {name} కోసం ఒక సెషన్ ఉంది. సర్వర్ ప్రొఫైల్, రోల్ గ్రాంట్లు మరియు జిల్లా పరిధిని ధృవీకరించిన తర్వాత మాత్రమే పనిస్థలం తెరుచుకుంటుంది.
signIn.unsentText: {count, plural, one {ఈ పరికరంలో # నివేదిక లేదా ముసాయిదా ఉంది.} other {# ఈ పరికరంపై నివేదికలు లేదా ముసాయిదాలు కలిగి ఉంది.}} నియంత్రణ గదికి చేరుకోలేదు. సైన్ అవుట్ చేయడం వలన ఆమె ఈ పరికరం నుండి తొలగించబడుతుంది.

error.title: కార్యాచరణ ప్రాప్తిని ధృవీకరించలేకపోయాము.
error.text: సర్వర్ చెల్లని లేదా ఊహించని గుర్తింపు ప్రతిస్పందనను తిరిగి ఇచ్చింది. ఏ కార్యస్థలం తెరవబడలేదు.

offline.title: ఆఫ్‌లైన్‌లో పని చేస్తోంది
offline.text: సర్వర్‌ను చేరుకోలేము. ఈ పరికరం ఖాతా కోసం చివరిగా నిర్ధారించిన సర్వర్‌ను యాక్సెస్ చేయడానికి ఉపయోగిస్తోంది, కనెక్షన్ తిరిగి వచ్చే వరకు ఏదీ దాని నుండి బయటకు వెళ్లదు.

health.pushConfigured: Push is configured ({sender}). Alerts still appear in the inbox whether or not a notification arrives.
health.pushNotConfigured: Push is not configured in this deployment. Every alert is in the inbox.
health.consecutiveFailures: {count, plural, one {# failed run} other {# failures in a row}}
health.observed: {observed} of {total} road sections have an observed state
health.scored: {scored} of {total} road sections have a risk score
health.facilities: {onGraph} of {total} facilities sit on the routing graph

update.ready: A new version is ready. Nothing is waiting to be sent, so it is safe to reload.
update.held: A new version is downloaded but held: {count, plural, one {# report has} other {# reports have}} not reached the control room yet. It will be offered once everything has been sent.
update.unsupported: This browser is not running a service worker, so there is nothing to update here.

pack.title: Offline data pack
pack.staleExplainer: This pack is past the age it should be trusted at. It still works and is still shown, because a missing map with no explanation is worse. Download a newer one when you can.
pack.activated: Verified against its published checksum and activated.
pack.manifestError: The pack list could not be read

report.title: New field report
report.lede: Everything here is kept on this device as you type, photo included, until the control room has it. Losing signal loses nothing.
report.gpsFailed: No GPS fix: {reason} Enter the position below instead.
report.gpsUnknownError: The device did not give a position.
report.pinRecorded: Recorded as a manual pin, not a GPS fix
report.manualHint: A position typed here or taken from the map is recorded as a pin. The reviewer sees the difference from a measured GPS fix.
report.photoKept: Kept on this device until the server has verified it.

photoRefused.too_large: This photo is larger than 5 MB. The original is the evidence, so it is not shrunk to fit. Take a smaller photo.
photoRefused.unsupported_type: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos can be attached.
photoRefused.storage_unavailable: This browser is not keeping local data, so the photo cannot be held until it is sent.

report.notePlaceholder: Lanes blocked, vehicles waiting, water depth…
report.notSaved: Not saved: this browser is not keeping local data
report.submitHint: The report is sent as soon as there is a connection.
report.queueFailed: The report could not be queued on this device.
report.discardConfirm: Discard this report and its photo from this device? This cannot be undone.
report.queuedBody: It stays on this device until the control room has it. You can close this page; it is sent when there is a connection.

check.verified: Verified by the server against the checksum

fieldHome.title: My field work
fieldHome.heading: Assigned to you
fieldHome.lede: Accepting, starting and submitting a task all work without signal: each move is kept on this device and sent once, in order.
fieldHome.error: Your assignments could not be loaded
fieldHome.queueFailed: That move could not be kept on this device.
fieldHome.moveNeedsAttention: This move needs your attention in the sync queue.

driverTrips.title: My trips
driverTrips.heading: Your trips
driverTrips.phoneOnly: Starting a trip, position reporting and delivery receipts happen in the RASTA driver app on your phone. A browser cannot keep reporting your position once the screen locks, so this page only shows your trips and routes.
driverTrips.error: Your trips could not be loaded
driverTrips.noRoute: The control room has not approved a route for this trip. Do not follow any other route as if it were approved.
driverTrips.routeError: The route could not be loaded
driverTrips.noGeometry: The approved route has no drawable line, so none is shown rather than a straight line between the ends.

planState.proposed: This route is only a proposal and has not been approved. Wait for the control room.
planState.superseded: This route was replaced by a newer one. Do not follow it; open the driver app for the current route.
planState.invalidated: The control room withdrew this route because the road changed. Do not follow it; wait for a new route.
planState.rejected: This route was rejected. Do not follow it; wait for the control room.

permissions.title: Device check
permissions.lede: Find out before you are on the road whether this device will let the app take a photo and a position.
permissions.checksBody: Each permission is requested only when you start its check.
permissions.localOnlyBody: These checks do not create a report, start tracking, or send a photo or position to any server.

camera.title: Camera
camera.idle: No camera request has been made.
camera.running: Waiting for the camera or file chooser.
camera.passed: A photo was taken on this device. It has not been uploaded or saved.
camera.previewAlt: Photo from the camera check, kept on this device

location.title: Current location
location.idle: No location request has been made.
location.running: Asking the device for one position fix.
location.passed: A position was received at {time}. It stays on this device.
location.passedWithAccuracy: A position was received at {time}, accurate to ±{accuracy} m. It stays on this device.
location.noCoordinates: Coordinates are deliberately not shown on this check.

error.camera_unavailable: This device or browser offers no camera to the app.
error.location_unavailable: This browser does not offer location to the app.
error.permission_denied: Permission was not granted. Allow it in the device settings and try again.
error.location_failed: No position was received before the request ended.
error.unknown: The device check failed without a recognised answer.

gate.frameBody: RASTA does not open operational views from a browser session alone.
gate.checkingBody: Verifying the active profile, role grants and district scope.
gate.unconfiguredBody: This build has no configured Supabase project URL and publishable key. No demo account or local bypass is available.

reason.scopeDenied: The server did not authorize this account for the requested workspace.
reason.sessionExpired: The API did not accept this browser session. Sign in again to renew it.
reason.unavailable: The identity service is unavailable, so role and district scope cannot be verified.
reason.signIn: Sign in with an administrator-assigned account to request a server-verified workspace.

gate.deniedTitle: This view is not available to this role
gate.deniedBody: The server-verified role grants do not allow this route. No data or action has been loaded.
gate.offlineNotice: Offline. Your access was last confirmed {when}. Reports are kept on this device and sent when the connection returns.
